nodes.statement:
The one curated model that loaded in both engines (BIOMD0000000633,
Bulik2016 hepatic glucose metabolism) shows near-perfect cross-engine
agreement (mean nRMSE 2.05e-07, bucket "Good"), independently
cross-validated by the committed full-corpus dataset's measurement of
the same model (1.61e-07, also "good") -- confirming COPASI and
Tellurium integrate this stiff hepatic-glucose ODE system to
numerically indistinguishable trajectories. The other 4/5 models fail
identically on a missing SED-ML file, a load-time gap rather than a
numerical disagreement.
